template.name: pignus/vault-threshold

params.label: Oracle key 1 of three, distinct from the others; a key nobody holds fills a slot the loan does not use
params.name: ORACLE_1

params.label: Oracle key 2 of three, distinct from the others; a key nobody holds fills a slot the loan does not use
params.name: ORACLE_2

params.label: Oracle key 3 of three, distinct from the others; a key nobody holds fills a slot the loan does not use
params.name: ORACLE_3

params.label: How many of the three oracles must attest a price, 1 to 3
params.name: THRESHOLD

params.label: Precision of the oracle's price: price / 10^PRECISION debt atoms per collateral atom
params.name: PRECISION

params.label: Liquidation threshold: the vault is unhealthy below this collateral ratio, in basis points
params.name: LIQ_BP

params.label: Liquidation target: a liquidation restores the vault at most to this collateral ratio, in basis points
params.name: TARGET_BP

params.label: Liquidation bonus: a liquidator seizes collateral worth at most this share of what it repays, in basis points
params.name: BONUS_BP

params.label: Maturity: from this Unix time anyone may call the loan at an attested price
params.name: MATURITY

params.label: Recovery: from this Unix time anyone may pay the whole collateral to the lender
params.name: RECOVER_AFTER

paths.effect: Pays the lender at output 2k+1 at least one atom of DEBT_ASSET. Below DEBT_OUT, output 2k is this vault again, holding the same collateral, owing DEBT_OUT less the payment; at or above it, output 2k pays the borrower at least the whole collateral and the vault closes. This coin is input k.
paths.name: repay

paths.effect: Output 2k is this vault again, with its state unchanged, holding more collateral than this coin. This coin is input k.
paths.name: top_up

paths.effect: With a price record (price, time) of COLL in DEBT_ASSET at PRECISION that at least THRESHOLD of ORACLE_1..3 attest in format 2, each presented slot's beacon live at an input of that oracle's BEACON_ASSET, the record newer than LAST_TIME and its time the transaction's lock time: pays the lender at output 2k+1 and repays r, that payment up to DEBT_OUT. Before MATURITY the vault must be under LIQ_BP at that price and r no more than takes it to TARGET_BP; from MATURITY any r. The liquidator keeps collateral worth at most r * BONUS_BP / 10000 at that price. Below DEBT_OUT, output 2k is this vault again with the rest of the collateral, owing DEBT_OUT less r, LAST_TIME the record's time, and at or above LIQ_BP at that price; at DEBT_OUT the vault closes, and output 2k, which must exist and be explicit, counts as returned what it pays the borrower in COLL. The three keys must be distinct and THRESHOLD at least 1. This coin is input k.
paths.name: liquidate

paths.effect: Once the lock time reaches RECOVER_AFTER, pays the lender at output 2k at least the whole collateral. This coin is input k.
paths.name: recover

slots.label: Debt outstanding, in the debt asset
slots.name: DEBT_OUT

slots.label: Time of the newest attestation a liquidation used, or of the loan's start
slots.name: LAST_TIME
